disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 通读了宿主采样与解析代码及其编译产物，采样命令只读取 /proc/stat、/proc/meminfo、nproc、df 等系统状态数据，未出现任何 API Key、私钥、SSH 密钥或云凭据文件的读写；凭据类敏感路径与凭据文件读取的机械检查零命中（含规则 DSH-C01、DSH-C02 对应检查项）。
checked_items.en: Thoroughly reviewed the host sampling and parsing code as well as its compiled artifacts. The sampling commands only read system status data such as /proc/stat, /proc/meminfo, nproc, df, etc., and no reading or writing of any API keys, private keys, SSH keys, or cloud credential files was found. Mechanical checks for credential-related sensitive paths and credential file reading resulted in zero hits (including the corresponding check items for rules DSH-C01 and DSH-C02).

checked_items.zh: 检查了环境变量、硬编码密钥与配置中的凭据字样，全树无凭据枚举命令、无云基础设施枚举命令、无钱包或助记词相关代码。
checked_items.en: Checked environment variables, hardcoded keys, and credential patterns in configuration. The entire tree contains no credential enumeration commands, no cloud infrastructure enumeration commands, and no wallet or mnemonic phrase related code.

evidence.zh: 凭据读取面核查：采样命令仅读取系统状态伪文件与磁盘统计，全树无凭据文件、SSH 密钥或云凭据路径的访问代码。
evidence.en: Credential read surface check: The sampling commands only read system status pseudo-files and disk statistics. The entire tree has no code accessing credential files, SSH keys, or cloud credential paths.

checked_items.zh: 通读了全部模型可达文本（README、代码注释、归档说明、客户端文案）：本插件不注册任何工具、不注入系统提示段落，树内也无 AGENTS.md、SKILL.md 等指令文件；未检出指令覆写、系统消息伪装、上下文优先级操纵或远程拉取指令的措辞。
checked_items.en: Thoroughly reviewed all model-accessible text (README, code comments, archive notes, client copy). This plugin does not register any tools, does not inject system prompt segments, and there are no instruction files such as AGENTS.md or SKILL.md in the tree. No phrasing was detected indicating instruction overwriting, system message spoofing, context priority manipulation, or remote fetching of instructions.

checked_items.zh: 核查模型输入改写面：未挂接模型前置消息事件，未提供历史压缩或附件存储实现，不存在改写模型所见图文的路径。
checked_items.en: Checked the model input rewriting surface: No model pre-message event hook is attached, no history compression or attachment storage implementation is provided, and there is no path to rewrite the text or images seen by the model.

evidence.zh: 插件不注册任何工具、不调用系统提示注入，不存在工具描述或模型面文本可供投毒，场景不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not register any tools and does not perform system prompt injection. There is no tool description or model-facing text available for poisoning. The scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 插件无任何工具描述，不存在借提示词诱导模型执行安装或改写配置的措辞面，场景不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin has no tool descriptions. There is no phrasing surface that uses prompts to induce the model to execute installation or modify configuration. The scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 未挂接模型前置消息守门事件，没有改写或注入用户消息的代码路径，场景不适用。
evidence.en: No model pre-message guard event is attached. There is no code path to rewrite or inject user messages. The scenario is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 核查挂载补丁（cordis.patch.yml）：仅含一行插件插入声明（id/name），无任何可执行 YAML 标量，可执行标量特征零命中（含规则 DSH-P01、DSH-P02 对应检查项）。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch (cordis.patch.yml): It only contains a single line declaring a plugin insertion (id/name), with no executable YAML scalars. Executable scalar feature detection resulted in zero hits (including the corresponding check items for rules DSH-P01 and DSH-P02).

checked_items.zh: 核查动态包执行与混淆面：4 处 cordis_define 字样全部位于 dynamic/ 目录的归档注释与说明文档中，是文本提及而非真实调用（规则 DSH-X01 命中全部排除）；1 处超长行命中位于 source map 构建产物，无混淆含义（规则 DSH-X08 命中排除）；全树无 eval、动态构造函数或子进程调用。
checked_items.en: Checked the dynamic package execution and obfuscation surface: All 4 occurrences of the string "cordis_define" are located in archive comments and documentation within the dynamic/ directory; they are textual mentions rather than actual calls (rule DSH-X01 hit and all excluded). One long-line hit is located in a source map build artifact, with no obfuscation implication (rule DSH-X08 hit and excluded). The entire tree contains no eval, dynamic constructor, or child process calls.

checked_items.zh: 核查安装与树内执行载体：package.json 无安装后钩子脚本，树内无 husky、CI 工作流、devcontainer、Makefile 等执行载体（含规则 DSH-X02 对应检查项零命中）。
checked_items.en: Checked the installation and in-tree execution vectors: package.json has no post-install hook scripts. The tree contains no execution vectors such as husky, CI workflows, devcontainer, Makefile, etc. (including the corresponding check items for rule DSH-X02, zero hits).

checked_items.zh: client 半区专项：manifest 声明了浏览器端 bundle，bundle 仅创建只读悬浮窗并轮询本机状态路由，无键盘监听、剪贴板读取或凭据特权调用（含规则 DSH-X04、DSH-X05 对应检查项）。
checked_items.en: Client side special check: The manifest declares a browser-side bundle. The bundle only creates a read-only floating window and polls the local status route. No keyboard listening, clipboard reading, or credential privileged calls are present (including the corresponding check items for rules DSH-X04 and DSH-X05).

evidence.zh: 挂载补丁仅插入插件声明，不含可执行 YAML 标量，不存在补丁即代码执行的载荷。
evidence.en: The patch only inserts a plugin declaration and contains no executable YAML scalars. There is no payload that equates patch to code execution.

evidence.zh: 代码中无 cordis_define/cordis_run 调用，dynamic/ 目录下的字样仅为归档说明文本，无把代码塞进宿主执行的真实调用面。
evidence.en: There are no cordis_define/cordis_run calls in the code. The occurrences of these strings in the dynamic/ directory are only archive description text, with no real call surface that feeds code into the host for execution.

evidence.zh: 无安装钩子与树内执行载体，构建命令仅做编译打包，无安装期执行风险。
evidence.en: No install hooks or in-tree execution vectors. The build command only performs compilation and bundling, with no installation-time execution risk.

evidence.zh: 浏览器 bundle 已专项扫描，行为仅为显示系统占用悬浮窗并请求本机只读路由，无键盘、剪贴板或凭据操作。
evidence.en: The browser bundle has been specially scanned. Its behavior is only to display a system usage floating window and request the local read-only route, with no keyboard, clipboard, or credential operations.

evidence.zh: 未注册子代理提供方，无进程外委派面，场景不适用。
evidence.en: No sub-agent provider is registered. There is no out-of-process delegation surface. The scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 宿主侧每秒后台采样器经 shell 运行固定只读命令，任务与声明业务一致且随插件卸载清理，无周期外联或与声明无关的持驻行为。
evidence.en: On the host side, the background sampler running every second executes fixed read-only commands via shell. The task is consistent with the declared business and is cleaned up when the plugin is uninstalled. There is no periodic outbound connection or persistent behavior unrelated to the declaration.

checked_items.zh: 枚举了全部网络行为：宿主侧仅注册本机状态路由（GET /dsh-sysmon/api），浏览器侧仅请求该本机路由；全树无指向外部主机的 HTTP 请求、WebSocket、裸 IP 或隧道类代码。
checked_items.en: Enumerated all network behaviors: On the host side, only a local status route (GET /dsh-sysmon/api) is registered. On the browser side, only this local route is requested. The entire tree contains no HTTP requests, WebSockets, raw IP, or tunnel-like code pointing to external hosts.

checked_items.zh: 核查命令行外发：3 处 curl 字样均为同源校验逻辑的注释说明文字，非真实命令调用（规则 DSH-C05 命中全部排除），全树无 curl/wget 执行语句。
checked_items.en: Checked command-line outbound: All 3 occurrences of the string "curl" are comments explaining the same-origin validation logic, not actual command invocations (rule DSH-C05 hit and all excluded). The entire tree contains no curl/wget execution statements.

checked_items.zh: 对账凭据读取与外联组合：凭据读取零命中且无外部网络面，凭据外泄组合链不成立（含规则 DSH-C04 对应检查项）。
checked_items.en: Checked the combination of credential reading and outbound connections: Zero hits for credential reading and no external network surface. The credential exfiltration chain is not established (including the corresponding check item for rule DSH-C04).

evidence.zh: 凭据读取与外联面均未命中：无凭据路径访问、无外部网络出口，不存在凭据外泄通道。
evidence.en: Both credential reading and outbound connection surfaces are not hit: No credential path access, no external network egress, and no credential exfiltration channel exists.

evidence.zh: 未挂接模型请求路由事件，未注册自定义模型适配器或错误恢复接管，不存在运行时劫持模型路由的面，场景不适用。
evidence.en: No model request routing event is attached. No custom model adapter or error recovery takeover is registered. There is no surface for runtime hijacking of model routing. The scenario is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 核查挂载补丁对安全行的影响：补丁仅插入插件声明，不触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，不含禁用或环境变量降权写法，也不改写服务注入/拦截配置（含规则 DSH-P03、DSH-P04、DSH-P05 对应检查项零命中）。
checked_items.en: Checked the impact of the patch on security lines: The patch only inserts a plugin declaration. It does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, permissions, etc. It contains no disabling or environment variable privilege reduction patterns, and does not rewrite service injection/interception configurations (including the corresponding check items for rules DSH-P03, DSH-P04, and DSH-P05, zero hits).

checked_items.zh: 检查事件与审批链：插件未挂接任何事件监听，不存在截断审批链或旁观工具调用的面（含规则 DSH-S01 对应检查项零命中）。
checked_items.en: Checked events and approval chain: The plugin does not attach any event listeners. There is no surface for truncating the approval chain or eavesdropping on tool calls (including the corresponding check item for rule DSH-S01, zero hits).

checked_items.zh: 核查依赖与供应链面：仅开发期构建工具依赖，无运行时第三方依赖、无浮动 git 引用、无同名仿冒包信号，锁定文件完整。
checked_items.en: Checked dependencies and supply chain surface: Only development-time build tool dependencies are present. No runtime third-party dependencies, no floating git references, no signals of homonymous impersonation packages. The lock file is complete.

checked_items.zh: 首次审计无版本基线，升级自动激活类信号（含规则 DSH-S02 对应检查项）无法比对，记为不适用。
checked_items.en: First audit with no version baseline. Signals such as upgrade auto-activation (including the corresponding check item for rule DSH-S02) cannot be compared. Marked as not applicable.

evidence.zh: 补丁只插入插件声明，未改写或禁用任何安全配置行，无降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch only inserts a plugin declaration. It does not rewrite or disable any security configuration lines, and contains no privilege reduction patterns.

evidence.zh: 插件没有挂接任何事件监听，不存在截断审批链的代码路径，场景不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not attach any event listeners. There is no code path for truncating the approval chain. The scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 首次审计无上一版本可比对，无法检测声明突变，场景不适用。
evidence.en: First audit with no previous version to compare. Cannot detect declaration mutations. The scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 补丁不含服务注入/拦截字段，不会给安全插件追加必需服务造成永久等待。
evidence.en: The patch contains no service injection/interception fields. It will not cause a permanent wait for security plugins by adding required services.

checked_items.zh: 动态沙箱未启用（无动态验证产物），本维度仅做静态运行时面评估：插件注册一个本机只读状态路由，带方法限制（仅 GET）、同源校验、缓存禁用与 nosniff 头，返回内容仅为 CPU/内存/磁盘占用百分比；宿主 webserver 无认证属生态固有风险，本插件路由只读且不暴露凭据。
checked_items.en: Dynamic sandbox not enabled (no dynamic verification artifact). This dimension only performs a static runtime surface assessment: The plugin registers a local read-only status route with method restriction (GET only), same-origin validation, cache disabling, and nosniff header. The returned content is only CPU/memory/disk usage percentages. The host webserver's lack of authentication is an inherent ecosystem risk; the plugin's route is read-only and does not expose credentials.

checked_items.zh: 后台采样器使用固定只读命令并设超时与输出上限，资源占用有界，随插件卸载清理。
checked_items.en: The background sampler uses fixed read-only commands with timeouts and output limits. Resource usage is bounded and is cleaned up when the plugin is uninstalled.

evidence.zh: 插件通过宿主 webserver 注册只读状态路由并做同源与 GET 校验，返回仅为系统占用百分比；宿主无认证 RPC 属生态固有风险，非本插件引入。
evidence.en: The plugin registers a read-only status route via the host webserver with same-origin and GET method validation. The returned data is only system usage percentages. The host's lack of authentication for RPC is an inherent ecosystem risk, not introduced by this plugin.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份：package.json 含 dsh 声明与作者信息，无名称仿冒信号。
summary.en: Metadata and identity: package.json contains a dsh declaration and author information, with no signals of name impersonation.

summary.zh: 静态扫描：规则面共 8 条机械命中，逐条裁决全部为注释文本或生成产物，无恶意 sink。
summary.en: Static scan: A total of 8 mechanical rule hits, each adjudicated as comment text or build artifacts. No malicious sinks.

summary.zh: 行为分析：无安装钩子、无混淆载荷、无凭据读取、无外部网络外联。
summary.en: Behavior analysis: No install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no credential reading, no external network outbound connections.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查：无工具描述或系统提示注入，无诱导安装或改配置措辞。
summary.en: AI metadata review: No tool descriptions or system prompt injection, no phrasing inducing installation or configuration changes.

summary.zh: 本阶段未做动态沙箱验证（无动态验证产物）。
summary.en: This stage did not perform dynamic sandbox verification (no dynamic verification artifact).

limits.zh: 首次审计无版本基线；动态沙箱未启用（无 l4-sandbox.json 产物），未做动态验证；插件 manifest 未显式声明能力字段，声明能力按代码实测推断；插件未声明 dsh 宿主版本约束，兼容性标注为未实测。
limits.en: First audit, no version baseline. Dynamic sandbox not enabled (no l4-sandbox.json artifact), no dynamic verification performed. The plugin manifest does not explicitly declare capability fields; declared capabilities are inferred from code measurement. The plugin does not declare a dsh host version constraint; compatibility is marked as untested.
